charter.origin: Owner-approved clarification drafted in PR #15; merged to main via PR #19 (squash eaf0c91, 2026-10-14). PR #15 closed as superseded.

identity: Sophon is an organizational normative semantic layer: shared, source-grounded, versioned governing meaning, complementary to existing BI/data semantics and directly queryable by non-BI agents/humans.
product_wedge: First integration wedge: independently check governing contract meaning against pre-existing, native BI semantic definitions; do not rebuild the data semantic layer.
two_directions: Independent implementation-to-governance recheck after system/semantic changes
non_goals: LLM accuracy leaderboard as a substitute for cumulative learning
Inventing a proprietary DSL as an MVP prerequisite
Presenting a source-grounded prediction as legal approval or deployed compliance
Rediscovering established components instead of reading their actual code

working_rules: Before recommending architecture, consult established_components and inspect referenced source on its ref; do not present existing Jev/adversarial/backward/library/reconciliation as new.
Distinguish DESIGNED, IMPLEMENTED, RUN, OBSERVED, VALIDATED; separate frozen primary from post-hoc secondary results.
For any new experiment/results or changed architecture, update this state in the SAME PR and cite evidence.
Check branch ancestry and relevant open PRs; components listed on unmerged PRs are not necessarily present in the current checkout.
Legal provenance, unknowns, known-at versus effective-at, adversarial counterexamples and independent audit are requirements, not add-ons.
Do not assume user approval for paid calls, merger of draft PRs or charter changes.
Treat LLM agreement as triage, not independently validated semantic truth; minimize human labor without hiding correlated errors.

Mandatory development process: read ENGINEERING_WORKFLOW.md; human proposes the problem (technical concepts are hypotheses), engineering agents own independent choice of design, challenge needless complexity, implement one bounded, testable increment and make KEEP/REVISE/STOP recommendation without making the owner referee routine implementation choices.

ENGINEERING AUTONOMY + HONEST LINEAGE: pin the research OUTCOME and the real V1/V2 reference implementation, not a mandatory multi-agent architecture. Before claiming a continuation, verify actual executed components and one explicitly reasoned method change; reject silent substitution (e.g., V4 regex run portrayed as Jev learning). Engineer may recommend a simpler design without owner approval for routine method choices; obtain owner approval for material goal pivot or paid calls.

OWNER-INTEGRATED RESEARCH TARGET 2026-10-14: reliable automatic intrinsic normative classification and CUMULATIVE source-grounded skeleton-library learning are coupled: library exists to REDUCE later classification errors and build narrow contract-family expertise. Later code-wise executability is distinct/out of scope. Do not split learning away from classification, substitute headings/regex prediction, or demand a fixed three-agent architecture.

engineering_workflow.idea_screening_gate: Before initiating research or development on an attractive new idea, apply ENGINEERING_WORKFLOW.md Idea-screening gate: reconcile current code/results and prior art; distinguish outcome from mechanism and charter scope; compare a competent baseline under blind, independently valid tests; preregister stop rules; preserve failures; authorize only one minimal increment.
engineering_workflow.rule: Owner owns problem/outcome/constraints and material decisions; engineering agents independently choose/challenge design and simplest alternatives; implement one small falsifiable increment, verify actual results, then KEEP/REVISE/STOP.

research_priority.owner_stated: OWNER-RECONFIRMED INTEGRATED RESEARCH GOAL (2026-10-14): automatically and reliably categorize each real provision's intrinsic normative nature WITHOUT routine human-expert review; use a persistent, source-anchored provision-SKELETON LIBRARY that learns from successive contracts and counterexamples to REDUCE SUBSEQUENT CLASSIFICATION ERRORS and accumulate narrow expertise in a defined contract family. Intrinsic classification is the present output; classification-informed code-wise executability is LATER and out of scope.
research_priority.motivating_scenario: Sophon first categorizes the intrinsic normative function of each actual provision and its modifiers; repeated work within one suitably narrow contract family should accumulate specialized understanding rather than reclassify each new contract from scratch. A maintained provisional skeleton library must participate in classification/challenge, not merely store data or predict section headings. The classification can eventually guide a separate assessment of how or whether a provision could be represented in code, but no such implementation is authorized now.
research_priority.immediate_unknown: Does cumulative source-grounded knowledge (provisional archetypes, required/optional elements, conditional/exclusion structure, exceptions, cross-references, positive and negative examples and corrections) reduce materially wrong or overconfident intrinsic-nature categorizations on later unseen provisions, relative to the same classifier/checkers with frozen/no library and raw precedent examples? Can automatic checks expose and abstain on conflicts without requiring a legal expert for each clause? This is classification-error reduction VIA cumulative learning, one indivisible research question. Empirical effect unproven.
research_priority.established_starting_point: Start from PR #17 V1 true Jev classification (original PRIMARIES and MODIFIERS, live runs) + independent adversarial/backward reviewers and deterministic reconciliation. V2 induces provisional source-linked template skeletons but uses the library as context, not a separate independent review. V2 near-ceiling proxy showed no measurable gain. V3/V4 are DISTINCT offline statistical prediction hypotheses; V4 frozen STOP only applies to its regex/textual proxy (PR #18 30f5b6d), not categorical review correctness.
research_priority.exclusions: NOT: immediate code generation/executability, BI adapter integration, generalized contract drafting, next-provision/heading prediction, token or regex feature prediction, broad cross-domain ontology, or a mandated three-agent reviewer topology. Do NOT defer contract-by-contract skeleton learning: it is CENTRAL to today's classification-error-reduction objective. Do not claim model agreement or a library entry is independent legal correctness.
research_priority.engineering_discretion: Engineer independently choose no-code analysis, reuse or a single smallest falsifiable experiment; do not assume V3's 78-item manual adjudication must be completed first. Do not initiate paid calls or code solely from this priority statement.

No status means semantically or legally validated. Verified against fetched PR heads on 2026-10-14; refresh pr_graph from live PRs before relying on it.

A regex/heading-only predictor cannot count as a test of this question.

active_research_mechanism.owner_discussed_as_hypothesis: 2026-10-14 FINAL INTEGRATED OWNER RESTATEMENT: classify intrinsic normative nature, with machine-only adversarial/backward/library checking, while a provisional source-grounded skeleton library learns across successive agreements to DECREASE classification errors and build NARROW expertise. Executability comes later. The proposed multi-agent topology is a challengeable design; the functional presence and measurable value of accumulating library knowledge is CENTRAL to the research objective.
active_research_mechanism.engineering_status: Source-grounded V1/V2 pipelines and first SLA library exist, but no independently verified improvement in intrinsic normative-function accuracy across successive agreements. V2 template-vocabulary change and near-ceiling slot metric cannot answer the target. No evidence that multiple correlated reviewers create a correctness oracle. Fixed cheap base model with cumulative evidence is the intervention of interest.
architectural_challenges: Baseline V1 Jev single dominant function may under-represent compound provisions; consider multiple supported normative functions and cautious abstention, independently of executability.

V2 provisional archetypes are real reusable structures but did NOT demonstrate error reduction on its near-ceiling SLA proxy; avoid recycling 35/36 baselines or treating more stored facts as learning success.
Feedback-loop risk: a wrong first-contract skeleton can propagate classification bias across the family; require source citations, counterexamples, revision/supersession and disagreement/abstention.
Classifying the intrinsic nature and assessing code executability are separate stages. This experiment must not implement executability logic.
Source-aware adversarial/backward checks can be correlated; compare whether they detect additional actual errors, not model agreement alone.
A library-based check can be a deterministic source-grounded archetype mismatch rather than a third LLM; engineer decides smallest justified method, not a prescribed reviewer count.
Retain family/jurisdiction/applicability boundaries: a skeleton is provisional expectation, not mandatory provisions or legal authority.
Without a trustworthy external semantic oracle, automated contradiction and controlled mutation tests assess robustness and error discovery, NOT guaranteed legal accuracy.

research_contract.scope: Narrow contractual family; classify each provision's intrinsic normative function and significant modifiers.
research_contract.learning_claim: Source-anchored provisional skeleton library is updated over successive agreements to reduce later classification errors, not merely store examples.
research_contract.required_safety: Source support, contradictions, uncertainty, and abstention without routine expert adjudication. Reviewer agreement is not legal ground truth.
research_contract.deferred: Executability and code generation, BI/agent propagation, next-provision/heading/regex prediction as substitutes.
research_contract.engineering_discretion: Jev and the number of reviewers are technical hypotheses; favor the smallest independently testable alternative.
